gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-chivo: Stentiga looks like bent paperclip wire, tracked wide, with strokes that never swell or thin out. Chivo, a plain sans, packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-chocolate-classic: Stentiga draws true monoline letters, tracked wide, while Chocolate Classical Sans carries a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Open, unhurried shapes are the one thing both fonts clearly share.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-comme: Spare and spaced-out: Stentiga draws every line, g included, in one unchanging weight, while Comme's lowercase fills most of the height. Smoothness without clutter is what both fonts clearly share.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-cossette-texte: Refined and widely tracked, Stentiga leads with stems and crossbars of matching thickness throughout. And Cossette Texte, a plain sans with a prominent x-height, should read steadily once the text runs on.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-duru-sans: Stentiga has no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning at all. Stentiga is best at standing out, spaced wide and uniform, while Duru Sans, a plain sans, is best at filling a line with open lowercase.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-fresca: Light and spaced-out: Stentiga's letter openings gape like a door left ajar, while Fresca is a sans with no calligraphic thinning. Stentiga makes the entrance; Fresca does the quiet work of reading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-funnel-sans: Wide tracking is the first thing Stentiga shows you. Stentiga is built to be noticed, while Funnel Sans, a sans-serif, is built to be read, with strokes that hold their width.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-gafata: Luxurious in its spacing, Stentiga draws downstrokes and connecting curves without any swelling or thinning. Gafata, a plain sans with short stalks over a tall band of letters, should read smoothly line after line.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-geist: Geist moves along on a level, quiet beat, no accents of weight. Words in this sans-serif form solid blocks rather than skylines, which gives Stentiga's wide-tracked display lines plenty of room to stand apart.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-georama: Approachable and unfussy, Stentiga swaps hairline joins for full-width stroke connections. And Georama, a sans-serif with a c like a bracelet pulled apart, makes the shared openness the pair's best quality.
